skill.name: momentic-explore-prompt
skill.description: Generate an explore-prompt.md file that gives Momentic's explore agent (`momentic ai explore diff` / `momentic ai explore latest`) repo-specific context — which applications to test, the URLs tests must target, how to authenticate, where to save generated tests, and repo quirks. Use when setting up or improving the prompt file passed via `--prompt-file`.
skill.summary: Create a repository-specific prompt for Momentic explore runs.
skill.author: momentic-ai

content.value_statement: Momentic explore runs fail when repository details, target URLs, authentication, and test paths are unclear. This skill produces a focused explore-prompt.md from verified repository facts.
actual_capabilities: Identifies application names and test target URLs from repository configuration.
Documents reusable login modules by name and identifier.
Defines required destination folders for generated Momentic tests.
Separates throwaway nested tests into a confirmed ignored directory.
Produces concise Markdown instructions for Momentic explore commands.
limitations: Requires access to repository configuration, workflows, and test folders.
Does not execute Momentic explore commands or validate generated tests.
Does not replace general Momentic test authoring guidance.
Cannot confirm URLs or authentication details that the repository does not document.

use_cases.title: Prepare a new repository
use_cases.description: Create the first explore-prompt.md with verified applications, URLs, authentication, and destination paths.

use_cases.title: Align continuous integration
use_cases.description: Match explore instructions to the URLs and services used by continuous integration workflows.

use_cases.title: Correct generated test placement
use_cases.description: Clarify mandatory prefixes and ignored folders when generated tests land in incorrect locations.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic explore prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this repository and create explore-prompt.md with each application, test URL, login method, and destination folder.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when adding Momentic explore support to one repository.

prompt_templates.title: Verify target URLs
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Momentic configuration with CI workflows, then update explore-prompt.md so every application uses its runtime test URL.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when local and CI URLs differ.

prompt_templates.title: Define placement rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Review existing Momentic tests and ignored paths, then add explicit destination prefixes and throwaway test rules to explore-prompt.md.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when generated tests are saved incorrectly.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a complex explore prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit explore-prompt.md against repository evidence for application mapping, authentication modules, runtime URLs, path constraints, persistent data, and flaky areas.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for multi-application repositories with specialized test behavior.

output_examples.input: Create an explore prompt for a dashboard that uses a shared login module and runs at the CI preview URL.
output_examples.output: A concise prompt names the dashboard, specifies its CI preview URL, identifies the login module, and defines the generated test folder.

output_examples.input: Fix an explore prompt that saves nested tests beside permanent tests.
output_examples.output: The revised prompt adds a mandatory permanent-test prefix and directs every nested throwaway test to the confirmed ignored folder.

best_practices: Verify every application, URL, login module, and folder against repository files.
Use runtime test URLs instead of local authoring URLs.
State mandatory path prefixes and throwaway test directories explicitly.
anti_patterns: Do not invent repository details from memory.
Do not repeat general Momentic behavior already covered elsewhere.
Do not leave placeholder names, URLs, module identifiers, or paths in the final prompt.

faq.question: What file does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates or improves explore-prompt.md for use with the Momentic --prompt-file option.

faq.question: Does this skill run Momentic tests?
faq.answer: No. It prepares repository-specific instructions for a later Momentic explore run.

faq.question: Which URL should each application use?
faq.answer: Use the URL that tests target during execution, confirmed through Momentic configuration and CI workflows.

faq.question: How should authentication be documented?
faq.answer: Name the reusable login module and include its exact identifier with any access assumptions.

faq.question: Where should generated tests be saved?
faq.answer: Use each application folder with every required path prefix. Put nested throwaway tests in the confirmed ignored directory.

faq.question: Can several prompt files be combined?
faq.answer: Yes. Momentic appends repeated prompt files before repeated inline prompts, preserving the order supplied.
